data.title: 黑馆晴奈 · 私密套房的红晕索吻
data.description: 只有城市夜景反光的高级套房落地玻璃幕墙前，晴奈被温柔抵在玻璃边缘。外衣领口被拉扯微开，向来高高在上的贵族大小姐双手紧紧抓着老师的领带，猩红美眸泛起从未见过的滚烫泪花与极致心动。近在咫尺的急促呼吸中，她微启双唇，等待着最终的亲吻。
data.location: luxury high-rise suite before panoramic night cityscape window
data.action: backed against window glass, gripping necktie, heavy blush, breathless parted lips, intense gaze
data.lighting: ambient city nightscape reflections from floor-to-ceiling windows
data.mood: breathless emotional surrender, pounding passion, and irresistible allure
data.promptProse: Pressed gently against the high-rise panoramic night window, Kurodate Haruna clutches the viewer necktie with flushed cheeks and melting ruby eyes, breathless with romantic passion.
data.animaCaption: Haruna looking up with heavy blush and trembling lips against the floor-to-ceiling night window.
